purpose: Repair padded clipping visibility, external-selector media updates, containing-block sizing contracts, and conditional bounded sizing.
approach: Use padding-box clipping dimensions, including border-box borders; watch padding/border sizing changes so padded zero-content-size panels can reveal and close normally.
Recheck installed media contracts for page attribute/structure changes because sibling selectors and :has() can alter author styles outside image ancestry.
Track authored containing-block declarations and, when CSSOM is incomplete, browser-computed sizing. Omit matching owned rules so container expansion does not look like a page policy change.

Keep incomplete bounded policies separate from their declaration signature. A synchronous non-rendered pseudo reads computed auto/percent/explicit sizing in a private first CSS layer; cleanup restores every borrowed rule and private marker.
Retain observed pixel fingerprints during viewport reflow while still detecting stable-viewport author sizing changes, keyword changes, and transitions into/out of collapsed sizing.
restorationContract: Production changes do not replace or edit authored text nodes, style attributes, classes, links, or ownership maps. The sizing read temporarily uses an owned marker and stylesheet and cleans both synchronously, including exceptional paths.
Normal session tests derive source identities, values, child order, additions, removals, link/code edits and transfer destinations from page operations.
Cross bilingual/replace, watching/paused, immediate/delivered records, responsive views, repeated restore and opposite-mode translation on fresh browser artifacts.
testAdjustments: Unit JSDOM lacks CSS layer parsing. Cleanup tests model layer insertion; native tests exercise real important author pseudo styles and layer priority.

An earlier intermediate336-case pass lacked the100vh environment control. A separate8-session source probe exposed an introduced viewport-only invalidation; the final build fixes it and the final native fixture includes the environment control. Intermediate logs/artifacts are retained separately.
The original Apple PageDown baseline did not scroll. Canonical Apple comparisons use actual native wheel900px in both builds; its region-banner source state is matched explicitly.
